actions.label: Trace Alt pass-through in excluded games

prerequisites: Use a current supported build and a game with an Alt-bound action; first use Sniper Elite 5 if available.
Confirm the game executable is in excluded apps and Game Mode suppression is enabled.
reproduce.version_requirements: Current supported build; Sniper Elite 5 or a reported Alt-bound game
reproduce.expected_result: Alt reaches the excluded game and its bound action works; Grab And Move remains enabled and does not activate for the excluded game.
steps: Launch the excluded game and verify its foreground window before pressing Alt.
Hold Alt without a mouse drag and check the game action; then test Alt with a drag in a safe desktop app.
Capture maintainer trace of foreground process/window, exclusion result, Game Mode result, and modifier down/up disposition.
Repeat with the executable temporarily removed from exclusions and compare results.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says Alt is unusable in Sniper Elite 5 despite Game Mode suppression and an excluded executable; separate users report Alt-bound actions failing in RuneLite, Titan Quest II, and Arc Raiders. Current Grab and Move source checks IsModifierExcluded on the foreground window before capturing the modifier and also chains input when Game Mode is detected. This does not explain why these reports bypass the pass-through path; the cause remains red.
evidence: Original report uses PowerToys 0.99.1 and says SniperElite5.exe is excluded while Game Mode suppression is enabled, yet holding Alt no longer triggers the game action.
Commenters report similar Alt-bound behavior in RuneLite and Titan Quest II; a later report adds Arc Raiders on Unreal Engine.
Grab And Move main.cpp checks the foreground process against modifierExcludedApps and chains the key when excluded; Game Mode detection also chains/pass-throughs.
The exact event sequence and foreground window at Alt keydown are not established.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with an excluded game and trace foreground-window identity, exclusion matching, Game Mode detection, and modifier/key-up disposition.

fix_assessment.rationale: Source contains explicit exclusion and Game Mode pass-through paths, but the reports do not show why the expected pass-through is missed.

issue_context.analysis: The cross-game reports support a reproducible input-interference issue. Source confirms the intended pass-through gates; instrument them before changing behavior.
inferences: The shared Alt symptom may involve modifier capture/pass-through timing or foreground-window identification, but no common cause is proven.
initial_investigation: Reviewed issue body and latest comments through 2026-10-15.
Inspected GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp: KeyboardProc/handler uses foreground exclusion and Game Mode checks before/after modifier session capture; no source fact identifies the failed gate.
known_information: Original report says SniperElite5.exe is excluded and Game Mode suppression is configured, but the Alt focus action works only when Grab And Move is disabled.
Other commenters cite RuneLite, Titan Quest II, and Arc Raiders (Unreal Engine) Alt-bound actions.
Current Grab And Move source checks foreground modifier exclusions before capturing the modifier and chains input when Game Mode is detected.
issue_context.summary: Grab And Move appears to interfere with Alt-bound game actions despite Game Mode suppression and an executable exclusion; multiple users report the symptom across game engines.

title: Grab And Move problem with Sniper Elite 5
author: kovesp
summary: The Grab And Move report describes screen does not fade.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Alt input for excluded games
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: Grab And Move may evaluate the foreground window or Game Mode state at a different point from the game's Alt input, or a captured modifier session may not be returned to the application across a focus transition. Current issue evidence does not prove this sequence.
plan: Reproduce using Sniper Elite 5 with its executable excluded and Game Mode suppression enabled; record foreground HWND/process at modifier keydown and mouse interaction.
Trace KeyboardProc modifier capture, IsModifierExcluded/MatchesExcludedApps, IsSuppressedByGameMode, and passthrough/key-up handling through the complete Alt hold/release.
Compare an excluded game with an unexcluded foreground app and repeat with Game Mode suppression toggled.
Fix only the confirmed transition that swallows Alt and add a focused regression test for excluded-app pass-through.
verification: In Sniper Elite 5, hold Alt without a mouse drag and confirm the game action works while Grab And Move remains enabled and the executable remains excluded.
Repeat with RuneLite or another reported Alt-bound game and confirm Alt is not captured.
Confirm Alt+drag still activates Grab And Move in a non-excluded application.

confidence.rationale: Several independent games report the same Alt failure, and source has explicit pass-through controls, but the actual missed condition is not identified.
